app_title: DMD GIF Creator 128x32 - AI Enhanced v3.0.2
restart_required: Please restart the application to apply the new language.
tooltip_pixel_perfect: Forces an integer scale factor and simulates the physical LED render in previews (spaced round dots, instead of a simple square upscale).
tooltip_letter_threshold: Minimum letter height (in pixels after resizing) below which text is judged unreadable and Fill/scroll mode is forced instead of Resize.
tooltip_scroll_speed: Scroll speed in pixels/frame for Fill mode. Below 1, frames are repeated to simulate slower-than-one-pixel scrolling.
tooltip_add_folder: Adds an entire folder (always scanned recursively, including subfolders).
tooltip_add_images: Adds one or several individual image files.
tooltip_reauthorize: Re-authorizes an image already marked as exported, allowing it to be processed again in a batch.
tooltip_tolerance: Color-matching sensitivity for the fill and magic eraser tools (0 = exact color only, 100 = every color).
tooltip_loop_mode: Normal: plays once. Ping-pong: plays forward then backward. Infinite: repeats continuously.
tooltip_easing: Changes the relative playback speed of the animation (speeds up/slows down the start or end) without changing the frame count or duration.
tooltip_bounce_edges: The sequence goes back and forth instead of stopping or looping abruptly at the end, within the same total duration.
tooltip_color_effect: Only active when Effect is set to "normal" — has no effect with the other styles (3d, fire, neon...).
tooltip_led_brightness: Simulates the LED panel's physical brightness: brighter pushes colors toward white and increases the glow bloom, dimmer darkens and reduces the glow. 50% = neutral render.
tooltip_led_zoom: Opens an enlarged, animated view of the current LED render (only available when DMD mode / pixel-perfect is checked).
video_no_cv2: ⚠️ opencv-contrib-python not installed — pip install opencv-contrib-python
tooltip_video_roi: In "✋ Manual" mode, click "➕ Point here" then draw a rectangle over the area to frame: it is set as a point on the timeline automatically on release. Click-drag inside the rectangle already shown to move it (live preview).
tooltip_video_crop_mode_tracking: A single rectangle, drawn once: a tracker (OpenCV) follows it automatically over the whole video to keep the subject in frame. No manual repositioning, no multi-point system; crop size computed automatically.
tooltip_video_crop_mode_auto_zoom: You position the framing yourself (drag the rectangle), but its size is computed automatically. No auto-tracking, no multi-point system — a single framing, movable at any time.
tooltip_video_crop_mode_manual: No automation: combine the point system ("➕ Point here"/"🔍 Zoom here", several zones and zoom levels over time) with the "Framing zoom" slider, entirely by hand.
tooltip_video_roi_edit_time: The cyan line/triangle is the framing time: drag it (without changing the trim selection) to navigate through the video and view/edit the active framing point at that instant. Use "➕ Point here" to set a new framing point, "🔍 Zoom here" for a zoom point, on the graphical timeline just below the filmstrip.
tooltip_video_playback: Looping preview of the source video (resized to fit). Click to open it full-size in the system's default player.
tooltip_video_add_roi_point: Clears the rectangle shown and waits for a new drawing over the area to track: draw it on the canvas, it is set automatically as a manual point on release, at the current framing time. Replaces the existing point if one is already very close.
tooltip_video_add_zoom_point: Sets a zoom point at the current framing time, with the current value of the "Framing zoom" slider — independent from framing points, interpolated over time once 2+ points are set.
tooltip_video_delete_roi_point: Deletes the point (framing or zoom, whichever is closer in time) nearest to the current framing time. "🗑️ Clear points" resets everything at once.
tooltip_video_events_timeline: Timeline of the points placed: orange disc = auto-tracking point, purple square = manual point, teal diamond = zoom point. Click-drag a point to move it in time.
